id: title:cvolzer3:retry mcp tool listing with backoff instead of looping

review.posthog_relevance: Desktop agent reliability and operational stability
review.reason: Adds bounded retry and exponential backoff to silent auto-refresh of MCP tool listings, preventing retry storms against upstream servers while preserving immediate failure reporting for manual refresh. This improves the reliability and operational stability of the Desktop agent's interaction with external tool providers.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the implementation of a bounded retry and exponential backoff, which is a substantive improvement to reliability. However, the actual benefit depends on the frequency and severity of transient failures in the upstream MCP server, which is not established by this code alone. No production incident or adoption data is available.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed here; only observations are recorded.

observations.behavior: Adds a bounded retry and exponential backoff for silent auto-refresh, while preserving immediate failure reporting for manual refresh.
observations.posthog_connection: Desktop agent refreshes MCP tool listings; this prevents a retry storm against an upstream server while still allowing recovery after a transient failure.
